A11yCaret.description: The accessibility caret: a position in a node's text.

offset.description: The position, in UTF-16 code units into the node's text.

A11yChange.description: One change to the accessibility tree.

node.description: The new version of the node, children included.

A11yChangeKind.description: The kind of an accessibility change.

oneOf.description: The node replaces the node with the same `id`.

A11yNode.description: A node of the accessibility tree.

chars.description: The box of every character of `text`, on the page of `bounds`.

children.description: The node's children, in reading order.

editable.description: Whether the user can edit the node's text.

id.description: The node's identifier, stable for its lifetime.

name.description: An accessible name where the content does not provide one.

text.description: The node's own text, on nodes that hold text.

A11yRole.description: The role of an accessibility node.

oneOf.description: A header cell of a column.

anyOf.description: A code or a short identifier, such as a message type.

ArgValue.description: One value in the `args` of an error or warning: only codes and numbers, never document content (spec §12).

BlobRef.description: A blob: bulk bytes kept outside the JSON (spec §3). On the C interface, its identifier, a positive integer; on the web, the bytes themselves as an `ArrayBuffer` (spec §3.2).

accessibility.description: Whether the shell bridges the accessibility tree to the platform.

clipboard_formats.description: The clipboard formats the shell can exchange, as MIME types.

ime.description: Whether the shell forwards input-method composition.

visible.description: Whether the shell should show it.

end.description: The code unit after the character.

rect.description: The character's box, in page coordinates.

start.description: The character's first UTF-16 code unit in the node's text.

CompositionPhase.description: The phase of an input method composition.

oneOf.description: A composition begins at the caret.
The composition's text or selection changed.
The composition ends; its text is discarded (committed text arrives as `input.text`).

DocOpen.description: `doc.open`: opens a document from a blob.

blob.description: The document's bytes. The v0 skeleton opens the mock document whatever they contain.

file_name_hint.description: The file name, for format detection and display only; never logged.

format_hint.description: The format, if the shell knows it, such as `docx`.

fonts.description: Fonts the document asks for that are missing.

page_count_estimate.description: How many pages the document is expected to have.

warnings.description: Problems found while opening, as Fluent messages.

Empty.description: A payload without fields: the payload of requests that need none, and the reply to requests that only succeed or fail.

EngineError.description: `engine.error`: an error without a request to answer, or a panic (spec §12).

args.description: Codes and numbers that explain the error; never document content.

message_id.description: A Fluent message identifier, for people.

recoverable.description: `true`: the engine kept its state. `false`: it discarded its session, and the shell starts a new one with `hello`.

oneOf.description: Not a JSON object of the envelope's shape, or not UTF-8.
`v` is not 0, or `hello` offers no common version.
A message other than `hello` before the handshake.
An unknown message type, or one v0 does not implement.
The payload does not have the message's shape, or a value is out of range.
An unknown document, blob, page or node.
The recording comes from another engine version, protocol version or layout epoch.
`diag.panic` without its test switch, or `diag.replay` while recording.
The engine panicked while handling the message.
Any other failure inside the engine.

ErrorInfo.description: The error of a failed reply (spec §4).

args.description: Codes and numbers that explain the error; never document content.

message_id.description: A Fluent message identifier, for people.

Event.description: A message the engine sends without being asked (spec §4).

seq.description: Increases by one with every event an engine instance sends.

FontReport.description: Fonts a document asks for that the engine does not have.

machine_dependent.description: Whether the layout depends on a font found only among the user's installed fonts (ADR-0004 §3).

locale.description: The interface language, as a BCP 47 tag.

protocol_versions.description: The protocol versions the shell speaks; must contain 0.

theme.description: The interface theme, such as `light` or `dark`.

ImageBitmapRef.description: An `ImageBitmap` transferred from the web worker (spec §3.2); only in the TypeScript declarations.

selection.description: The input method's caret or selection within `text`.

code.description: The physical key, as the DOM's `KeyboardEvent.code`, such as `KeyA`.

composing.description: Whether an input method composition owns the key; the engine then ignores it.

key.description: The key's meaning, as the DOM's `KeyboardEvent.key`, such as `Backspace` or `ArrowLeft`.

repeat.description: Whether the key repeats because it is held down.

InputPointer.description: `input.pointer`: a mouse, pen or touch event.

button.description: The button, numbered as the DOM's `button`: 0 is the primary button.

clicks.description: The click count: 2 for a double click.

x.description: The horizontal position, in device-independent pixels from the view origin.

y.description: The vertical position, in device-independent pixels from the view origin.

text.description: The text, inserted at the caret.

Modifiers.description: The modifier keys held during an input event.

meta.description: Meta (Command on macOS, the Windows key on Windows).

OverlayUpdate.description: `overlay.update`: what the shell draws over the tiles (spec §6.3).

caret.description: The caret, or `null` when there is none.

highlights.description: Find highlights (Phase 2); always empty in v0.

remote.description: Other people's cursors (Phase 3); always empty in v0.

section.description: The index of the page's section.

x.description: The page's left edge in view space.

y.description: The page's top edge in view space.

PageRect.description: A rectangle on a page, in that page's coordinates.

rect.description: The rectangle, in BLU from the page's top-left corner.

oneOf.description: A finger on a touch screen.

node.description: The node whose subtree to return; the whole document when omitted.

blob.description: The recording (spec §10), as a blob that the shell releases.

truncated.description: Whether a limit stopped the recording early.

Rect.description: A rectangle in BLU (1/25,400 point, ADR-0005).

RenderInvalidate.description: `render.invalidate`: parts of pages whose tiles the shell must request again.

regions.description: The changed regions, in page coordinates.

RenderTile.description: `render.tile`: asks for the pixels of part of a page (spec §6.4).

device_scale.description: Physical pixels per device-independent pixel, a hint for later rasterizers; it does not change the pixels.

height.description: The tile's height in pixels, 1 to 4,096.

mode.description: The rasterizer to use (ADR-0011 §3); both give the same pixels in v0.

rect.description: The part of the page, in page coordinates.

width.description: The tile's width in pixels, 1 to 4,096.

zoom.description: The zoom factor, a hint for later rasterizers; it does not change the pixels.

RenderTileReply.description: The reply to `render.tile` in the message form, on the C interface.

blob.description: The pixels, premultiplied RGBA8, rows from top to bottom, as a blob that the shell releases.

hash.description: The digest of the pixels, `fnv1a64:` and 16 hexadecimal digits (spec §10).

stride.description: Bytes from the start of one row to the next: 4 × width.

RenderTileWebReply.description: The reply to `render.tile` as the web worker host delivers it (spec §3.2): the pixels as an `ImageBitmap`. This type exists for the TypeScript declarations; no JSON has this shape.

hash.description: The digest of the engine's premultiplied pixels (spec §10).

first_difference.description: The index of the first entry that did not, or `null`.

identical.description: Whether every entry produced exactly what it produced when it was recorded.

tiles.description: Every tile rendered during the replay.

ReplayTile.description: A tile rendered during a replay.

entry.description: The index of the entry that rendered it.

Reply.description: The engine's reply to a request with an `id` (spec §4).

ReplyOk.description: A successful reply. Its payload has the reply type that `x-bayan-messages` lists for the request.

type.description: The reply's name, where the specification gives one (`welcome`, `doc.opened`).

Request.description: A message from the shell to the engine (spec §4). Without `id`, the engine sends no reply.

platform.description: The operating system or browser it runs on.

TextRange.description: A range of UTF-16 code units.

end.description: The code unit after the last one; equal to `start` for an empty range (a caret).

UiCommand.description: A command of the UI manifest.

UiGroup.description: A group of a ribbon tab.

commands.description: The identifiers of its commands, in order.

UiManifest.description: The UI manifest: a stub in v0 (spec §6.8).

locale.description: The language of the strings, as a BCP 47 tag.

page_count_estimate.description: How many pages the document is expected to have.

pages_laid_out.description: The number of pages laid out so far.

oneOf.description: Print layout: pages as they print.

ViewPages.description: `view.pages`: the document's pages and where they sit in view space (spec §7).

ViewSet.description: `view.set`: tells the engine what the shell shows.

show_formatting_marks.description: Whether to show paragraph marks and other formatting marks.

viewport.description: The visible part of the page area, in device-independent pixels from the view origin.

zoom.description: The zoom factor: 1 shows a document at its real size.

Warning.description: A problem found while opening a document.

args.description: Codes and numbers for the message.

features.description: What this engine offers, such as `mock_document`.

protocol_version.description: The protocol version of the session: 0.

description: Every message of engine protocol v0 (BayanDocs docs repository, specs/engine-protocol.md), generated from the engine's Rust types. A message is a request, a reply or an event.
